notes: Very competitive: the page says 331 applied and 25 were chosen in 2025. The application link may be the 2026 form, so check the program page for the next one.
name: Department of Surgery High School Mentorship Program
what_you_do: Learn about health careers through school visits and Saturday hands-on sessions (suturing, surgery practice, tours). Some students get a paid 7-week summer internship with a one-on-one mentor.
who_can_apply: Detroit-area high school students who are curious about health care. No medical experience needed. Grades and school districts are not listed.
pay_detail: Program is free. Summer interns get a $1,000 stipend for 7 weeks.
duration: 7-week summer internship. Saturday sessions during the school year.
deadline_text: 2026 internship application closed April 30, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Submit the online internship application form linked on the summer internship page. For the program, email iokerek1@hfhs.org or call 313-916-2698.
